collapse-on-scroll.description: Compact an extended FAB on viewport scroll down and restore on scroll up.

extended.description: Show the action label next to its icon.

href.description: A nonempty destination renders an anchor. Relative URLs and fragments retain native resolution.

icon-name.description: Registered Lucide name. Import the icon module before rendering. The icon slot takes precedence.

label.description: Accessible name of the action. Also the visible text in the extended state.

position.description: Fixed sits at the viewport's block-end inline-end corner. Reserve page clearance there.

size.description: Square footprint when icon-only, and minimum size when extended.

variant.description: Surface and ink: strong primary, tinted secondary or raised surface.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-fab-backdrop-filter.description: Complete optional filter behind the FAB.

--ki-fab-bg-image.description: Optional layer painted over the FAB fill.

--ki-fab-collapse-duration.description: Duration of the extended FAB footprint change.

--ki-fab-collapse-easing.description: Easing of the extended FAB footprint change.

--ki-fab-fg.description: Ink on the tinted secondary FAB.

--ki-fab-font-size.description: Text size for extended FAB labels.

--ki-fab-font-weight.description: Text weight for extended FAB labels.

--ki-fab-forced-colors-border-width.description: Boundary width for the FAB in forced colors.

--ki-fab-gap.description: Space between icon and label in an extended FAB.

--ki-fab-hover-shadow.description: FAB elevation for a pointer that can hover.

--ki-fab-icon-size.description: Glyph size of the default FAB.

--ki-fab-lg-icon-size.description: Glyph size of the medium FAB.

--ki-fab-lg-radius.description: Corner radius of the medium FAB.

--ki-fab-lg-size.description: Minimum footprint of the medium FAB.

--ki-fab-line-height.description: Line height for extended FAB labels.

--ki-fab-mobile-nav-block-size.description: Height to reserve for mobile navigation, excluding the safe-area inset.

--ki-fab-offset.description: Fixed FAB gap to the viewport edge or mobile navigation.

--ki-fab-padding-inline-end.description: Inline end padding of an extended FAB.

--ki-fab-padding-inline-start.description: Inline start padding of an extended FAB.

--ki-fab-primary-fg.description: Ink on the strong primary FAB.

--ki-fab-radius.description: Corner radius of the default FAB size.

--ki-fab-size.description: Minimum FAB footprint in the default size.

--ki-fab-surface-fg.description: Ink on the raised surface FAB.

--ki-fab-xl-icon-size.description: Glyph size of the large FAB.

--ki-fab-xl-radius.description: Corner radius of the large FAB.

--ki-fab-xl-size.description: Minimum footprint of the large FAB.

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

component.description: The primary action of a screen, as an icon or an extended control with a visible label.

click.description: Native activation click. The page or guarded renderer handles the declared action.

control.description: The native button or link, including its surface and focus ring.

icon.description: Wrapper for the decorative named or slotted glyph.

label.description: Visible label of an extended FAB.

collapseOnScroll.description: Compact an extended FAB on viewport scroll down and restore on scroll up.

extended.description: Show the action label next to its icon.

href.description: A nonempty destination renders an anchor. Relative URLs and fragments retain native resolution.

iconName.description: Registered Lucide name. Import the icon module before rendering. The icon slot takes precedence.

label.description: Accessible name of the action. Also the visible text in the extended state.

position.description: Fixed sits at the viewport's block-end inline-end corner. Reserve page clearance there.

size.description: Square footprint when icon-only, and minimum size when extended.

variant.description: Surface and ink: strong primary, tinted secondary or raised surface.

icon.description: Decorative, noninteractive icon replacing the named glyph.
